vat_rates.legal_product_description: Standard rate of Goods and Services Tax (GST — Sierra Leone's VAT-equivalent) on the supply of goods and services by registered vendors, and on the importation of goods.
vat_rates.normalized_product_description: standard rate of goods and services tax on the supply of goods and services by registered vendors, and on the importation of goods.
vat_rates.rate_basis: GST-exclusive value of the taxable supply or import
vat_rates.legal_reference: Goods and Services Tax Act 2009, Section 14(3): « The rate of GST applicable to a taxable supply or import is— (a) if the supply or import is zero-rated under the First Schedule, zero per cent; (b) in any other case, 15 per cent. »

vat_zero_rated.legal_product_description: Export of goods excluding rutile and its by-products, iron ore, bauxite, gold, diamonds and other minerals
vat_zero_rated.normalized_product_description: exports of goods, excluding certain minerals
vat_zero_rated.legal_reference: Goods and Services Tax Act 2009, First Schedule, item 1.

vat_zero_rated.legal_product_description: Goods shipped as stores on vessels and aircraft leaving Sierra Leone
vat_zero_rated.normalized_product_description: goods shipped as vessel/aircraft stores leaving the country
vat_zero_rated.legal_reference: Goods and Services Tax Act 2009, First Schedule, item 2.
